gaps.explanation: Governmental funds statement p4 (printed p7) Operating transfers in: General 759,738 + Road and Bridge 1,630,000 + Self-Insured Medical 609,728 + Other Nonmajor 6,626 = 3,006,092. The nonmajor 6,626 is the E-911 (Wireless 911) Fund: combining schedule p25 (printed p46) E-911 Fund column prints Operating transfers in 6,626, Operating transfers out (426), total 6,200, which ties to that fund's change (32,177) + 6,200 = (25,977) and fund balance 119,442 -> 93,465. The Wireless 911 budget schedule p17 (printed p37), which detail used, prints the two amounts the other way round (transfers in 6,200, transfers out 6,626, total (426)), which does not tie to its own (25,977). Detail transfers in 759,738 + 1,630,000 + 609,728 + 6,200 = 3,005,666. Fix: replace detail[50] Transfers In 6,200 with the p25 Transfers In 6,626. Check: 3,005,666 - 6,200 + 6,626 = 3,006,092.
